#!/bin/sh
# CUPS backend that atomically archives one unmodified payload per CUPS job.
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
export PATH
archive_dir=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'direct archive "Electronic Archive" "CUPS raw job archiver"'
    exit 0
fi

if [ "$#" -lt 5 ] || [ "$#" -gt 6 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "ERROR: invalid backend argument count" >&2
    exit 1
fi

job_id=$1
title=$3
case "$job_id" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*)
        printf '%s\n' "ERROR: invalid CUPS job id" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

safe_title=$(printf '%s' "$title" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_' | cut -c 1-80)
[ -n "$safe_title" ] || safe_title=payload
destination=$archive_dir/$job_id-$safe_title.raw
temporary=$(mktemp "$archive_dir/.job-$job_id.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'rm -f "$temporary"' 0 1 2 3 15
chmod 0640 "$temporary" || exit 1

if [ "$#" -eq 6 ]; then
    cat -- "$6" > "$temporary" || exit 1
else
    cat > "$temporary" || exit 1
fi

# A hard link publishes the complete payload atomically and refuses overwrite.
if ! ln "$temporary" "$destination"; then
    printf '%s\n' "ERROR: archive destination already exists for job $job_id" >&2
    exit 1
fi
rm -f "$temporary"
trap - 0 1 2 3 15
printf '%s\n' "INFO: archived CUPS job $job_id" >&2
exit 0
